status: MODEL (search over the HW-02 design space: analytical kernel bounds + K3 detailed replay; not FROZEN, does not change the published point)

constraints: every H-core kernel of the required models hides its vector work (kernel bound >= core MACs:lanes)
K3 detailed replay at the published point with only vectorLanes (and, for native input, the unpack) changed reaches the contract target of requirements.contractEntry
the die, with the shared-port charge and the option overheads, stays within its area and power limits (O.evaluate feasibility, then the die-area limit on the figure that includes both)
8 dies at that area plus the memory cubes fit the placement window less the observed keep-out (requirements.packageFit)
objective: least die area including the option overheads
designSpace.note: only the winning design is written here; the alternatives stay in the design space and in the document, section 2.5

packageFit.keepOutReason: the observed keep-out of the published point, 658.29 / 5248 (teams/hardware/inputs/physical_design_space.json, reserveFraction option 0.1254: recorded as observed, not chosen). A tighter reserve is an unverified ASSUMPTION there and is deliberately not used here to admit a candidate
packageFit.reason: 8 compute dies at the candidate's die area (shared-port charge included) plus the memory cubes must fit the placement window less the keep-out. The published point leaves 67.17 mm2 (09_PACKAGE_POWER_RAS.md; it left 0.189 mm2 before the shared-port reclaim of ADR-0023), so an option may add at most that room divided by the 8 dies to the die area

vectorOps.evidence: ASSUMPTION (O-006): indexer ReLU + weighted FMA across index heads; threshold/radix top-k select over the scored context; KDA per-channel decay + delta update; KDA matrix FLOPs as k3_operator_sram_sim (7 x B x heads x 128 x 128). Softmax ops per score belong to the expUnit dimension

lowPrecisionInput.evidence: P1 published point: BF16-only tensor engines; every sub-BF16 operand is dequantized on the vector lanes at TECH.unpackParamsPerLaneCycle

expUnit.evidence: ASSUMPTION (O-006): exp as a range reduction plus polynomial on the ALU lanes, 18 ops per score; no SFU area

lanesPerCoreClass.chosen: one lane count for L and H cores
lanesPerCoreClass.reason: A.physical() and mappedPlan() have a single vectorLanes, so a per-class split cannot be replayed on the detailed model yet. L cores need about 4:1 for B=1 GEMV unpack and H cores 44-100:1, so a split would save area; revisit after the model is extended

tmaDecode.chosen: decode in the tensor engine or on the vector lanes
tmaDecode.reason: not modeled: decoding in TMA writes BF16 into local SRAM, 2-4x the bytes of FP8/MXFP4, and the TMA/local write-port model (O-007) does not charge it yet

batch.reason: the published point is B=1 decode; the GEMV bounds for B up to 16 are reported as sensitivity
